answers.label: Comments on opposition to QC4
answers.text: This revision would make the use of contractual instruments impossible in countries with low data availability, as is the case in many emerging markets. Accessing those contractual instruments is already a very difficult task, but adding hourly matching makes it impossible. This will discourage contractual instrument providers, who will only be able to include a very small share of the revenue from these instruments in their business case.
